prompt.project_info: Ultra-realistic editorial menswear portrait with a classic gentleman aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved young adult male with short styled brown hair and groomed beard, serious neutral expression, wearing a navy double-breasted pinstripe suit, blue striped shirt, and burgundy red polka-dot tie.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 centered medium portrait, straight-on perspective, symmetrical framing against a black door with white architectural trim; face and red tie are primary focal points.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright soft diffused frontal natural/window light, neutral temperature, faint soft shadows under chin, professional and refined mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic digital photography, tack-sharp subject, medium depth of field, high-contrast navy-white-burgundy palette, clean texture and no grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 3:4 photorealistic editorial portrait of one generic approved young adult man in a navy double-breasted pinstripe suit, blue striped shirt, and burgundy polka-dot tie, centered before a black door with white trim; face and tie in sharp focus, soft diffused frontal light, sophisticated classic menswear mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, warped pinstripes, illegible tie pattern, watermark, logo overlay
